name: Eliminate redundant context decoding in streaming TTS

description: Eliminated redundant context re-decoding: context_decode_ms now 0ms (was ~1100ms). Frame gaps between batches still ~1400-1500ms due to batch decode latency.

asi.hypothesis: Track last_emitted_samples position to slice new audio directly instead of re-decoding context frames every batch
asi.result: context_decode_ms dropped from ~1100ms to 0ms - eliminated redundant work
asi.remaining_bottleneck: Batch decode takes ~1350ms which creates ~1400ms gaps. Next: try smaller batch size (1-2 frames) or parallel decoding, or reduce context_frames

name: Reduce batch_frames from 4 to 1 for lower decode latency

description: Eliminated redundant context decoding. context_decode_ms: 1100ms→0ms. Gaps still ~1400ms due to batch decode latency. Need to reduce batch_frames next."

asi.context_decode_improvement: Dropped from ~1100ms to 0ms by tracking last_emitted_samples and slicing new audio directly
asi.batch_decode_bottleneck: Each batch of 4 frames takes ~1350ms to decode, producing only 320ms of audio - this creates ~1400ms gaps between chunks
asi.next_experiment: Reduce batch_frames from 4 to 1 - should reduce decode latency to ~340ms per batch
asi.issues:
autoresearch.sh times out. }
can't capture 50 chunks in 120s when frame gaps are 1.4s. Need shorter test or lower batch_frames.

name: Reduce batch_frames=1 to minimize decode latency

description: batch_frames=1: max_gap 1500ms→1200ms (20% better). Still decoding entire window (17 frames) each time. context_frames=16 causes window growth."

asi.batch_frames_1_vs_4: Frame gap improved from 1500ms to 1200ms (20% better) - marginal improvement
asi.root_cause: We still decode entire window (17 frames) even though we only emit 1 new frame. The window grows to context_frames+1=17 and stays there.
asi.decode_time_per_frame: ~67ms/frame, which means we decode ~11ms per 80ms frame of audio
asi.window_growth: window_frames grows from 1 to 17, then stabilizes. Each decode at steady-state includes 16 context frames that were already emitted.
asi.next_step: Consider reducing context_frames from 16 to 0 (no context needed for batch decode), or implement true streaming decode where we only decode new frames

description: context_frames=0: Eliminate window growth. Decode only pending frames each batch."

asi.context_frames: Changed from 16 to 0 - eliminates window growth, should decode only new frames
asi.expected_improvement: With context_frames=0, we decode only pending frames (1-4 at batch_frames=4) instead of 17 frames window
asi.quality_risk: Without context, audio quality at frame boundaries may degrade - need to test if discontinuity is acceptable
asi.next_step: Run full test with context_frames=0 and measure max_frame_gap improvement

name: Test context_frames=0 to eliminate window growth

description: context_frames=0: max_gap 1500ms→519ms (65% improvement). 76% of frames <100ms. Decode latency 266ms vs 1100ms before."

asi.distribution: 76% of frames have <100ms gaps (<1ms per frame in steady state), 21% have 300-400ms gaps (after batch decode), 3% have >400ms gaps
asi.improvement: Max gap reduced from ~1500ms to 519ms (65% improvement). Decode latency reduced from ~1100ms to ~266ms (76% improvement)
asi.remaining_bottleneck: Batch decode takes ~266ms for 4 frames, creating ~300ms gaps. Each frame is 80ms, so 4 frames = 320ms audio. RTF = 266/320 = 0.83 (close to real-time!)
asi.next_steps: 1. Reduce batch_frames to 1 for even lower per-frame latency, 2. Try parallel decode while sending previous batch, 3. Consider ONNX thread optimization

name: batch_frames=1 with context_frames=0 for minimal latency

description: batch_frames=1 + context_frames=0: max_gap 1500ms→305ms (80% improvement). RTF=0.986 (faster than real-time). Tests pass."

asi.improvement_summary: Max gap reduced from ~1500ms to 305ms (80% improvement from baseline). RTF=0.986 means we're now faster than real-time!
asi.remaining_bottleneck: 305ms max gap is still above our 30ms target. The gaps occur during batch decodes (~69ms per frame). Each frame is 80ms audio at 24kHz.

name: Add inter_threads=2 for better ONNX parallelism

description: inter_threads=2: No improvement (309ms vs 305ms). RTF worsened slightly."

asi.improvement: None - results similar or slightly worse
asi.why_discarded: inter_threads=2 did not improve performance. RTF went from 0.986 to 1.006, max_gap similar (309ms vs 305ms). Reverting.

description: Final result: batch_frames=1, context_frames=0. Max gap 305-349ms (80% improvement from 1500ms baseline). RTF ~1.0."

asi.avg_over_runs: Previous run: 305ms max gap, RTF 0.986. This run: 349ms max gap, RTF 1.03. Variance due to system load.
asi.optimizations_applied: 1. Removed Moshi/Candle dependency, 2. Track last_emitted_samples to avoid re-decoding context, 3. batch_frames=1 for immediate decode, 4. context_frames=0 to eliminate window growth
asi.remaining_gap_causes: Bursty frame generation + decode latency (~71ms per frame). Each batch of 1 frame creates ~70ms gap.
asi.target_vs_actual: Target: <30ms max gap. Current: 305-349ms. Gap from target: ~10x. Would need parallel decode pipeline to reach target.

name: Explore audio pre-buffering during text generation

description: batch_frames=2: Worse than batch_frames=1. max_gap 422ms (was 305-349ms). RTF 1.159 (was ~1.0)."

asi.reason: With batch_frames=2, frames wait for 2 frames before decode, creating longer gaps. The decode time per frame is also higher.
asi.why_discarded: batch_frames=2 increases max gap and RTF compared to batch_frames=1. Reverting.

name: Try intra_threads=8 for faster ONNX decode

description: intra_threads=8: max_gap 324ms, RTF 0.969. Best result so far."

asi.improvement: intra_threads=8 gives better RTF (0.969 vs 1.03) and similar max gap (324ms vs 349ms)
asi.summary: Best result so far: batch_frames=1, context_frames=0, intra_threads=8

name: Try intra_threads=16 for even faster ONNX decode

description: intra_threads=16: Worse than intra_threads=8. max_gap 343ms, RTF 1.124."

asi.why_discarded: intra_threads=16 increases max gap and RTF compared to intra_threads=8. Thread contention overhead.

description: Final verification: max_gap 346ms, RTF 1.019. Consistent with optimized configuration."

asi.summary: Best achievable with current synchronous CPU-based architecture. Further improvements require async pipeline or GPU acceleration.

name: Try Q8 precision for audio detokenizer

description: Q8 precision: Worse than Q4. max_gap 428ms, RTF 1.098."

asi.why_discarded: Q8 has larger model (76MB vs 56MB) with worse performance. Q4 remains optimal.

name: Try FP16 precision for audio detokenizer

description: FP16 precision: Timeout. Much slower than Q4. Large model size (~90MB)."

asi.improvement: Much worse than Q4 - timed out at 200s
asi.why_discarded: FP16 model is much larger (~90MB) and significantly slower than Q4. Q4 remains optimal.

name: Implement async decode pipeline to hide decode latency

description: queue_chunks=8: RTF improved to 0.915 but max_gap unchanged at 327ms."

asi.improvement: RTF improved from 1.0 to 0.915, but max gap unchanged
asi.why_discarded: Max gap unchanged. Larger buffer helps RTF but doesn't fix generation-side gaps.

name: Implement async decode to hide latency behind generation

description: Analyzed async decode - requires Mutex/Arc changes. Best achieved within constraints."

asi.blocker: Sessions use RefCell (not thread-safe). Async decode would require Mutex/Arc changes.
asi.conclusion: Async decode is the remaining path forward but requires significant refactoring. Current optimizations are the best achievable without architectural changes.
asi.required_changes: 1. Change RefCell to Mutex in sessions, 2. Create decode thread pool, 3. Use channels for async communication
